# Mission Control

Top row = needs attention (anything not green is a to-do). Second block = every pipeline's age as a % of its schedule budget: 100% means the latest run that should have finished has not landed. Bottom = headline numbers. HA up can be blank when the home status file is stale; the status-age tile is the one to act on.

Bot Ops.description: Routine and pipeline health vs schedule, emit.py collectors (duration, errors), traces, box resources, and the runbook.

options.markdown:
# Bot Ops

**Budget** = time since the latest scheduled run that should have finished, plus that pipeline's allowance. **Age ratio** = hours since last success ÷ budget; ≥100% means a run was missed. The *Pipeline overdue* detector fires after 2 overdue hourly samples (calendar, finance, home, jobs, trader, ls_trading); email, birds and backup have their own detectors.

| Pipeline | Schedule (PT) | Allowance | If red |
|---|---|---|---|
| email | every 2h, 6:04a-10:04p | 1.5h | rerun the email refresh routine |
| calendar | every 2h, 6:04a-10:04p | 1.5h | rerun the calendar refresh routine |
| birds | hourly | 1.25h | rerun the bird-detection sync |
| backup | nightly ~2:00a | 5h | check the latest backup log and rerun the backup routine |
| finance | daily ~6:00a | 2.5h | rerun the finance refresh routine |
| home | 6:20a, then every 4h to 10:20p | 2h | rerun the home-status refresh (read-only) |
| jobs | ~7:45a and ~2:45p | 3h | wait for the next job scan or rerun it |
| trader | every 15m in market hours (NYSE days) | 1h | check the trading heartbeat file during regular hours |
| ls_trading | hourly :15, 6a-10p | 1h | rerun the trading status sync |
| ebay | fixed 9h budget | - | rerun the sales sync routine |
| golf | fixed 8-day budget | - | refresh handicap data after a posted round |

options.markdown:
# Golf

**Diff to beat** = the 8th-best differential in the last 20 rounds: post a lower one and it counts. **Gross to beat** converts that at the last course's rating/slope. **Oldest round counts = 1** means the next posted round pushes out a counting score, so the index can rise.

options.markdown:
# Birds

**Typical by now** = average detections up to this hour over the previous 14 days. **Rare** = species with under 10 detections ever, heard today. **Hours since last detection** is normally high overnight; a large value in daylight means the station or mic is down, not the sync.
